evaluation.experience_summary: 4+ years as a Backend Developer specializing in Python, FastAPI, and Django. Extensive experience optimizing PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases, alongside robust deployment skills using Docker, AWS ECS, and GitHub Actions.
evaluation.education_summary: B.S. in Computer Science from University of Technology (2015-2019).
evaluation.reasoning: Candidate perfectly aligns with the requirements, boasting strong backend Python experience (FastAPI, Django), database proficiency (PostgreSQL, MongoDB), and cloud infrastructure knowledge.

evaluation.experience_summary: Over 5 years of professional IT and software engineering experience. Worked on data processing scripts in Python, maintained internal Flask applications, and wrote automated bash scripts.
evaluation.education_summary: A.S. in Information Technology from Community College (2014-2016).
evaluation.reasoning: Candidate has some foundational Python and Flask experience, but lacks modern backend architecture skills like FastAPI, NoSQL, CI/CD, and Docker. Education is below the required Bachelor's degree in Computer Science.

evaluation.experience_summary: 3 years of experience as a Frontend Developer building responsive websites with React, Next.js, and interacting with REST APIs.
evaluation.education_summary: B.A. in Graphic Design from State University (2016-2020).
evaluation.reasoning: Candidate is entirely focused on front-end development (React/Next.js). They have zero Python backend experience, completely missing the core requirements of the job description.
